questions.stem: A 57-year-old patient presents with otalgia and dysphagia. A CT scan reveals bilateral calcification of the stylohyoid ligaments, consistent with Eagle syndrome. During surgical repair of this condition, which pharyngeal arch-derived nerve is most likely to be affected due to its proximity?
